Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E017.
Note 1 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: write

Note 2 (ticket 1):
  - role: Analyst (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security check: Jennifer Miller (E017) is a contractor with basic security training. Contractors may have read, or write only with advanced training; write is not permitted with basic training. Requested write exceeds the maximum allowed, so recommend read.
reason: HR records (the authoritative source for employment type) identify Jennifer Miller (E017) as a full-time Analyst. Full-time employees may have up to write, with admin only if their role owns the system; Source Code is owned by the Engineer role, not Analyst. The requested level (write) is at the maximum allowed and is not above it, so the requested write access is granted. (Note: the Security note lists her as a contractor, but employment type is an HR fact, and the HR record is authoritative here.)
